title: Kurokuzu - Black Pudding and Vinegar Crunch
description: A savory solo-dinner Japanese dish featuring fermented black pudding combined with a crispy vinegar coating, suitable for Jain-friendly diets.
instructions: In a mixing bowl, mix black pudding and sesame seeds thoroughly.
Add salt to taste and continue mixing until the mixture is evenly coated with sesame seeds.
Transfer the mixture onto a non-stick skillet or a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Heat the skillet over medium heat. Once heated, add vinegar in a small amount at a time, spreading it evenly on the black pudding mixture as it melts and coats the surface.
Once all vinegar is incorporated, cook until the top layer of the mixture starts to brown, approximately 5-7 minutes.
Remove from heat, let cool slightly before serving.
